vendored.name: better-auth-cloudflare
vendored.replaceWhen: Replace the build with the npm release once one includes the vendored commit (DECISIONS D-010 names the settings the tests need).

vendored.name: CharDB
vendored.replaceWhen: Move the CharDB examples to the npm release once its better-auth peer range includes 1.7 (D-066); until then, refresh the build when upstream has fixes worth having, and check an existing database through the upgrade.

held.name: Prisma 7 (adapter tests only)
held.because: Prisma 7 pulls in mysql2 3.15.3, with GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr (high) and GHSA-rgwj-5xj2-c3m3, and changes its setup.
held.takeWhen: a Prisma 7 release depends on a patched mysql2 (then drop the ignore in .github/dependabot.yml).

held.name: TypeScript 7 in the CharDB examples
held.because: CharDB's Vite plugin uses the TypeScript JS API (ts.ScriptTarget), which TypeScript 7's native compiler doesn't ship.
held.takeWhen: CharDB's Vite plugin no longer needs it, or TypeScript 7 ships the JS API.

held.name: npm's bundled dependencies (release job)
held.because: they're bundled inside npm, so they can't be updated alone; their alerts are dismissed as tolerable risk.
held.takeWhen: Dependabot proposes the newer npm (it does on its own); check its alerts close.

monthly: Is the public demo (examples/workers-hono) running the latest release? Redeploy it if not (its README has the command).
